     3→-- FAZ 4.2 — DAMAGE_PIPE_RUPTURE_KIT_01 (M13)
     4→-- 4 adet PIPE_SPOOL modülünün RUPTURED (patlamış) karşılıkları: gerçek içi
     5→-- delik yırtık güdükler (dikiş patlaması + dişli ağız + et kalınlığı), aynı
     6→-- uç/flanş düzlemleri, yarık kriyo bantlar, kıvrık metal parçacıklar ve
     7→-- hacimsel sızıntı hunisi için ağız ankrajları (MOUTH_A / MOUTH_B).
     8→-- Parçalar GIZLI dogar (Transparency=1); degisim mekanigi INTACT gizle <->
     9→-- RUPTURED goster seklindedir, tetikleme Faz 6'da baglanacaktir.
    10→-- MeshBin cekirdegi Faz 3'ten birebir alinmistir (ayni palet/flans/bant).
    11→-- ============================================================================

    13→local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
    14→local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
    15→
    16→local assembly = Workspace:WaitForChild("REACTOR_MESH_ASSEMBLY", 60)
    17→if not assembly then
    18→	warn("[FAZ4] REACTOR_MESH_ASSEMBLY bulunamadi; Faz 4.2 kurulumu atlandi.")
    19→	return
    20→end
    21→local staticRoot = assembly:WaitForChild("STATIC", 15)
    22→if not staticRoot then return end
    23→
    24→-- Temiz idempotensi: yalniz kendi Faz4Generated cocuklarini sil
    25→for _, ch in ipairs(staticRoot:GetChildren()) do
    26→	if ch:GetAttribute("Faz4Generated") then
    27→		ch:Destroy()
    28→	end
    29→end

    31→local ORIGIN_Y = 26.50
    32→
    33→local function toStudioPos(x, y, z)
    34→	return Vector3.new(x, ORIGIN_Y + z, -y)
    35→end
    36→
    37→local function toStudioVec(vx, vy, vz)
    38→	local v = Vector3.new(vx, vz, -vy)
    39→	local m = v.Magnitude
    40→	return m > 1e-6 and (v / m) or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
    41→end

    47→local MAT_DEFS = {
    48→	nickel_pipe = {rgb = Color3.fromRGB(128, 136, 148), mat = Enum.Material.Metal, refl = 0.09},
    49→	pipe_bore   = {rgb = Color3.fromRGB( 24,  28,  35), mat = Enum.Material.Metal, refl = 0.02},
    50→	gunmetal    = {rgb = Color3.fromRGB( 46,  51,  60), mat = Enum.Material.Metal, refl = 0.04},
    51→	flange      = {rgb = Color3.fromRGB(156, 164, 176), mat = Enum.Material.Metal, refl = 0.11},
    52→	clamp       = {rgb = Color3.fromRGB( 40,  45,  54), mat = Enum.Material.Metal, refl = 0.03},
    53→	cryo_band   = {rgb = Color3.fromRGB( 46, 110, 180), mat = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, refl = 0.02},
    54→	torn_steel  = {rgb = Color3.fromRGB( 70,  60,  62), mat = Enum.Material.Metal, refl = 0.05},
    55→	frost       = {rgb = Color3.fromRGB(168, 188, 210), mat = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, refl = 0.01},
    56→}

    58→local NON_SHADOW = {}
    59→
    60→local function applyMat(part, key)
    61→	local d = MAT_DEFS[key] or MAT_DEFS.gunmetal
    62→	part.Color = d.rgb
    63→	part.Material = d.mat
    64→	part.Reflectance = d.refl or 0
    65→end

    67→local MeshBin = {}
    68→MeshBin.__index = MeshBin
    69→
    70→function MeshBin.new()
    71→	return setmetatable({chunks = {}, active = {}}, MeshBin)
    72→end
    73→
    74→function MeshBin:getBucket(key, addVertCount)
    75→	addVertCount = addVertCount or 0
    76→	local b = self.active[key]
    77→	if (not b) or (#b.vs + addVertCount > 24000) then
    78→		b = {matKey = key, vs = {}, ns = {}, uvs = {}, fs = {}}
    79→		self.active[key] = b
    80→		self.chunks[#self.chunks + 1] = b
    81→	end
    82→	return b
    83→end
    84→
    85→function MeshBin:addRaw(key, v_list, f_list, hardCrease, uvScale)
    86→	local estVerts = hardCrease and (#f_list * 3) or #v_list
    87→	local b = self:getBucket(key, estVerts)
    88→	uvScale = uvScale or 10.0
    89→	if hardCrease then
    90→		for _, tri in ipairs(f_list) do
    91→			local p1, p2, p3 = v_list[tri[1]], v_list[tri[2]], v_list[tri[3]]
    92→			local s1 = toStudioPos(p1[1], p1[2], p1[3])
    93→			local s2 = toStudioPos(p2[1], p2[2], p2[3])
    94→			local s3 = toStudioPos(p3[1], p3[2], p3[3])
    95→			local cr = (s2 - s1):Cross(s3 - s1)
    96→			if cr.Magnitude > 1e-7 then
    97→				local nrm = cr.Unit
    98→				local base = #b.vs
    99→				b.vs[base + 1] = s1; b.vs[base + 2] = s2; b.vs[base + 3] = s3
   100→				b.ns[base + 1] = nrm; b.ns[base + 2] = nrm; b.ns[base + 3] = nrm
   101→				b.uvs[base + 1] = Vector2.new((p1[1] + p1[2] * 0.5) / uvScale, (p1[3] + p1[2] * 0.3) / uvScale)
   102→				b.uvs[base + 2] = Vector2.new((p2[1] + p2[2] * 0.5) / uvScale, (p2[3] + p2[2] * 0.3) / uvScale)
   103→				b.uvs[base + 3] = Vector2.new((p3[1] + p3[2] * 0.5) / uvScale, (p3[3] + p3[2] * 0.3) / uvScale)
   104→				b.fs[#b.fs + 1] = {base + 1, base + 2, base + 3}
   105→			end
   106→		end
   107→	else
   108→		local base = #b.vs
   109→		local accN = table.create(#v_list, Vector3.zero)
   110→		local stV = table.create(#v_list)
   111→		for i, p in ipairs(v_list) do
   112→			stV[i] = toStudioPos(p[1], p[2], p[3])
   113→		end
   114→		for _, tri in ipairs(f_list) do
   115→			local i1, i2, i3 = tri[1], tri[2], tri[3]
   116→			local cr = (stV[i2] - stV[i1]):Cross(stV[i3] - stV[i1])
   117→			if cr.Magnitude > 1e-7 then
   118→				accN[i1] += cr; accN[i2] += cr; accN[i3] += cr
   119→				b.fs[#b.fs + 1] = {base + i1, base + i2, base + i3}
   120→			end
   121→		end
   122→		for i, p in ipairs(v_list) do
   123→			b.vs[base + i] = stV[i]
   124→			local nm = accN[i]
   125→			b.ns[base + i] = nm.Magnitude > 1e-7 and nm.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
   126→			b.uvs[base + i] = Vector2.new((p[1] + 25.0) / uvScale, (p[3] + 22.0) / uvScale)
   127→		end
   128→	end
   129→end

   132→function MeshBin:cylVec(key, aVec, bVec, r, segs, hard, capped)
   133→	local dx, dy, dz = bVec.X - aVec.X, bVec.Y - aVec.Y, bVec.Z - aVec.Z
   134→	local L = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
   135→	if L < 1e-4 then return end
   136→	local fwd = Vector3.new(dx / L, dy / L, dz / L)
   137→	local ref = math.abs(fwd.Z) < 0.92 and Vector3.zAxis or Vector3.xAxis
   138→	local uAx = fwd:Cross(ref).Unit
   139→	local vAx = fwd:Cross(uAx).Unit
   140→	local vs, fs = {}, {}
   141→	for ring = 0, 1 do
   142→		local o = ring == 0 and aVec or bVec
   143→		for j = 0, segs - 1 do
   144→			local th = 2 * math.pi * j / segs
   145→			local p = uAx * (math.cos(th) * r) + vAx * (math.sin(th) * r)
   146→			vs[#vs + 1] = {o.X + p.X, o.Y + p.Y, o.Z + p.Z}
   147→		end
   148→	end
   149→	for j = 0, segs - 1 do
   150→		local k = (j + 1) % segs
   151→		local a, b, c, d = j + 1, k + 1, segs + j + 1, segs + k + 1
   152→		fs[#fs + 1] = {a, b, d}; fs[#fs + 1] = {a, d, c}
   153→	end
   154→	self:addRaw(key, vs, fs, hard == true, 8.0)
   155→	if capped ~= false then
   156→		local cap0, cap1, cf0, cf1 = {{aVec.X, aVec.Y, aVec.Z}}, {{bVec.X, bVec.Y, bVec.Z}}, {}, {}
   157→		for j = 1, segs do
   158→			cap0[j + 1] = vs[j]
   159→			cap1[j + 1] = vs[segs + j]
   160→		end
   161→		for j = 1, segs do
   162→			local k = (j % segs) + 1
   163→			cf0[#cf0 + 1] = {1, k + 1, j + 1}
   164→			cf1[#cf1 + 1] = {1, j + 1, k + 1}
   165→		end
   166→		self:addRaw(key, cap0, cf0, true, 8.0)
   167→		self:addRaw(key, cap1, cf1, true, 8.0)
   168→	end
   169→end
   170→
   171→function MeshBin:cyl(key, ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, r, segs, hard)
   172→	self:cylVec(key, Vector3.new(ax, ay, az), Vector3.new(bx, by, bz), r, segs or 12, hard, true)
   173→end

   175→-- GERÇEK İÇİ DELİK (ET KALINLIKLI) ENDÜSTRİYEL BORU PRİMİTİFİ!
   176→-- Dış yüzey (keyOuter, rOut) + İç delik yüzey (keyInner, rIn) + İki uçta halka et kalınlığı!
   177→function MeshBin:hollowPipeVec(keyOuter, aVec, bVec, rOut, rIn, segs, ringStart, ringEnd, keyInner)
   178→	local dx, dy, dz = bVec.X - aVec.X, bVec.Y - aVec.Y, bVec.Z - aVec.Z
   179→	local L = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
   180→	if L < 1e-4 then return end
   181→	segs = segs or 16
   182→	rIn = rIn or (rOut * 0.72)
   183→	keyInner = keyInner or "pipe_bore"
   184→	local fwd = Vector3.new(dx / L, dy / L, dz / L)
   185→	local ref = math.abs(fwd.Z) < 0.92 and Vector3.zAxis or Vector3.xAxis
   186→	local uAx = fwd:Cross(ref).Unit
   187→	local vAx = fwd:Cross(uAx).Unit
   188→
   189→	local vOut, fOut = {}, {}
   190→	local vIn,  fIn  = {}, {}
   191→	for ring = 0, 1 do
   192→		local o = ring == 0 and aVec or bVec
   193→		for j = 0, segs - 1 do
   194→			local th = 2 * math.pi * j / segs
   195→			local cs, sn = math.cos(th), math.sin(th)
   196→			local pO = uAx * (cs * rOut) + vAx * (sn * rOut)
   197→			local pI = uAx * (cs * rIn)  + vAx * (sn * rIn)
   198→			vOut[#vOut + 1] = {o.X + pO.X, o.Y + pO.Y, o.Z + pO.Z}
   199→			vIn[#vIn + 1]   = {o.X + pI.X, o.Y + pI.Y, o.Z + pI.Z}
   200→		end
   201→	end
   202→	for j = 0, segs - 1 do
   203→		local k = (j + 1) % segs
   204→		local a, b, c, d = j + 1, k + 1, segs + j + 1, segs + k + 1
   205→		fOut[#fOut + 1] = {a, b, d}; fOut[#fOut + 1] = {a, d, c}
   206→		-- İç cidar normalleri merkeze bakar!
   207→		fIn[#fIn + 1]   = {a, d, b}; fIn[#fIn + 1]   = {a, c, d}
   208→	end
   209→	self:addRaw(keyOuter, vOut, fOut, false, 8.0)
   210→	self:addRaw(keyInner, vIn,  fIn,  false, 8.0)
   211→
   212→	if ringStart ~= false then
   213→		local vr, fr = {}, {}
   214→		for j = 1, segs do
   215→			vr[j] = vOut[j]
   216→			vr[segs + j] = vIn[j]
   217→		end
   218→		for j = 0, segs - 1 do
   219→			local k = (j + 1) % segs
   220→			local o0, o1 = j + 1, k + 1
   221→			local i0, i1 = segs + j + 1, segs + k + 1
   222→			fr[#fr + 1] = {o0, i1, o1}; fr[#fr + 1] = {o0, i0, i1}
   223→		end
   224→		self:addRaw(keyOuter, vr, fr, true, 8.0)
   225→	end
   226→	if ringEnd ~= false then
   227→		local vr, fr = {}, {}
   228→		for j = 1, segs do
   229→			vr[j] = vOut[segs + j]
   230→			vr[segs + j] = vIn[segs + j]
   231→		end
   232→		for j = 0, segs - 1 do
   233→			local k = (j + 1) % segs
   234→			local o0, o1 = j + 1, k + 1
   235→			local i0, i1 = segs + j + 1, segs + k + 1
   236→			fr[#fr + 1] = {o0, o1, i1}; fr[#fr + 1] = {o0, i1, i0}
   237→		end
   238→		self:addRaw(keyOuter, vr, fr, true, 8.0)
   239→	end
   240→end

   242→function MeshBin:hollowPipe(keyOuter, ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, rOut, rIn, segs, ringStart, ringEnd)
   243→	self:hollowPipeVec(keyOuter, Vector3.new(ax, ay, az), Vector3.new(bx, by, bz), rOut, rIn, segs or 16, ringStart, ringEnd)
   244→end
   245→
   246→local function alignAxisBasis(axisVec)
   247→	local zt = axisVec.Unit
   248→	local up = math.abs(zt.Z) < 0.92 and Vector3.zAxis or Vector3.xAxis
   249→	local xa = up:Cross(zt).Unit
   250→	local ya = zt:Cross(xa).Unit
   251→	return xa, ya, zt
   252→end

   254→-- GERÇEK ORTASI AÇIK (DELİKLİ) ANSI BORU FLANŞI!
   255→-- Dış etrafı saran yakalı halka (rInner = pipeR * 0.99 -> borunun kendi pipe_bore cidarıyla %0 eş-düzlemli çakışma!)
   256→function MeshBin:hollowFlange(centerVec, axisVec, pipeR, bolts, _rIn)
   257→	bolts = bolts or 8
   258→	local rWrap = pipeR * 0.992
   259→	local xa, ya, zt = alignAxisBasis(axisVec)
   260→	local flR = pipeR * 1.46 + 0.08
   261→	local flT = math.max(0.14, pipeR * 0.28)
   262→	self:hollowPipeVec("flange", centerVec - zt * (flT * 0.46), centerVec + zt * (flT * 0.46), flR, pipeR * 1.18 + 0.04, 18, true, true, "gunmetal")
   263→	self:hollowPipeVec("gunmetal", centerVec - zt * (flT * 0.92), centerVec + zt * (flT * 0.92), pipeR * 1.16 + 0.03, rWrap, 16, true, true, "gunmetal")
   264→	local boltR = pipeR + 0.62 * (flR - pipeR)
   265→	local bRad = math.max(0.035, pipeR * 0.075)
   266→	for bi = 0, bolts - 1 do
   267→		local ang = 2 * math.pi * bi / bolts
   268→		local wp = centerVec + xa * (boltR * math.cos(ang)) + ya * (boltR * math.sin(ang))
   269→		self:cylVec("clamp", wp - zt * (flT * 0.85), wp + zt * (flT * 0.85), bRad, 6, true, true)
   270→	end
   271→end
   272→
   273→-- GERÇEK İÇİ DELİK 90° SÜPÜRMELİ BORU DİRSEĞİ!
   274→
   275→local emittedCount = 0
   276→function MeshBin:emitToModel(parentModel, namePrefix, collide)
   277→	local jobs = {}
   278→	for idx, b in ipairs(self.chunks) do
   279→		if #b.fs > 0 then
   280→			jobs[#jobs + 1] = {idx = idx, b = b}
   281→		end
   282→	end
   283→	local created = 0
   284→	local BATCH = 10
   285→	local jIdx = 1
   286→	while jIdx <= #jobs do
   287→		local bEnd = math.min(#jobs, jIdx + BATCH - 1)
   288→		local remaining = bEnd - jIdx + 1
   289→		local caller = coroutine.running()
   290→		local resumed = false
   291→		for k = jIdx, bEnd do
   292→			local item = jobs[k]
   293→			task.spawn(function()
   294→				local okRun, errRun = pcall(function()
   295→					local idx, b = item.idx, item.b
   296→					local key = b.matKey
   297→					local minX, minY, minZ = math.huge, math.huge, math.huge
   298→					local maxX, maxY, maxZ = -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
   299→					for _, v in ipairs(b.vs) do
   300→						if v.X < minX then minX = v.X end; if v.X > maxX then maxX = v.X end
   301→						if v.Y < minY then minY = v.Y end; if v.Y > maxY then maxY = v.Y end
   302→						if v.Z < minZ then minZ = v.Z end; if v.Z > maxZ then maxZ = v.Z end
   303→					end
   304→					local center = Vector3.new((minX + maxX) * 0.5, (minY + maxY) * 0.5, (minZ + maxZ) * 0.5)
   305→					local em = AssetService:CreateEditableMesh()
   306→					local vids = table.create(#b.vs)
   307→					local nids = table.create(#b.vs)
   308→					local uvids = table.create(#b.vs)
   309→					for i = 1, #b.vs do
   310→						vids[i] = em:AddVertex(b.vs[i] - center)
   311→						nids[i] = em:AddNormal(b.ns[i])
   312→						uvids[i] = em:AddUV(b.uvs[i])
   313→					end
   314→					for _, tri in ipairs(b.fs) do
   315→						local i1, i2, i3 = tri[1], tri[2], tri[3]
   316→						local fid = em:AddTriangle(vids[i1], vids[i2], vids[i3])
   317→						em:SetFaceNormals(fid, {nids[i1], nids[i2], nids[i3]})
   318→						em:SetFaceUVs(fid, {uvids[i1], uvids[i2], uvids[i3]})
   319→					end
   320→					local ok, st, content = pcall(function()
   321→						return AssetService:CreateDataModelContentAsync(Content.fromObject(em))
   322→					end)
   323→					local mp
   324→					if ok and st == Enum.CreateContentResult.Success and content then
   325→						pcall(function() em:Destroy() end)
   326→						mp = AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(content)
   327→					else
   328→						mp = AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromObject(em))
   329→						pcall(function() em:Destroy() end)
   330→					end
   331→					mp.Name = string.format("%s__%s_%02d", namePrefix, key, idx)
   332→					mp.Anchored = true
   333→					mp.CanCollide = collide == true
   334→					mp.CanTouch = false
   335→					mp.CanQuery = false
   336→					mp.CastShadow = not NON_SHADOW[key]
   337→					mp.CFrame = CFrame.new(center)
   338→					applyMat(mp, key)
   339→					mp.Parent = parentModel
   340→					created += 1
   341→					emittedCount += 1
   342→				end)
   343→				if not okRun then warn("[FAZ4] emit err:", errRun) end
   344→				remaining -= 1
   345→				if remaining == 0 and not resumed then
   346→					resumed = true
   347→					task.spawn(caller)
   348→				end
   349→			end)
   350→		end
   351→		if remaining > 0 and not resumed then
   352→			coroutine.yield()
   353→		end
   354→		jIdx = bEnd + 1
   355→	end
   356→	return created
   357→end

   360→-- ============================================================================
   361→-- FAZ 4.2 YIRTIK GUDUK URETECLERI (onayli GLB geometrisinin Luau karsiligi)
   362→-- ============================================================================
   363→local function makeRng(seed)
   364→	local s = seed % 2147483647
   365→	if s <= 0 then s += 2147483646 end
   366→	return function()
   367→		s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647
   368→		return (s - 1) / 2147483646
   369→	end
   370→end
   371→
   372→local function pipeBasis(fwd) -- hollowPipeVec ile ayni baz (sarmal yonu uyumu)
   373→	local ref = math.abs(fwd.Z) < 0.92 and Vector3.zAxis or Vector3.xAxis
   374→	local uAx = fwd:Cross(ref).Unit
   375→	local vAx = fwd:Cross(uAx).Unit
   376→	return uAx, vAx
   377→end
   378→
   379→-- Yirtik guduk: boyuna dikis patlamasi + tek yone sismis, duzensiz disli agiz.
   380→-- Iceri gercek delik (rOut 0.50 / rIn 0.36) + dudakta et kalinligi + don halkasi.
   381→local function tornStub(bin, origin, dir, len, seed, phase, damage)
   382→	local rng = makeRng(seed)
   383→	local uAx, vAx = pipeBasis(dir)
   384→	local NSEG = 36
   385→	local stations = {0, 0.20, 0.42, 0.62, 0.76, 0.87, 0.95, 1.0}
   386→	local rawR, segRand, finger = {}, {}, {}
   387→	for i = 1, NSEG do rawR[i] = 0.45 + 0.55 * rng(); finger[i] = rng() end
   388→	for i = 1, NSEG do
   389→		local prev = rawR[i == 1 and NSEG or i - 1]
   390→		segRand[i] = 0.5 * (rawR[i] + prev)
   391→	end
   392→	local function flare(t)
   393→		if t < 0.76 then return 1 end
   394→		local u = (t - 0.76) / 0.24
   395→		return 1 + 0.34 * damage * (u * u * (3 - 2 * u))
   396→	end
   397→	local function angDist(a, b)
   398→		local d = math.abs(a - b) % (2 * math.pi)
   399→		return math.min(d, 2 * math.pi - d)
   400→	end
   401→	local function deform(th, t, rim, idx)
   402→		local u = t < 0.62 and 0 or (t - 0.62) / 0.38
   403→		local bulge = 0.30 * damage * (math.max(0, math.cos(th - phase)) ^ 2) * u
   404→		local seam = math.exp(-(angDist(th, phase) ^ 2) / (2 * 0.28 ^ 2)) * (0.20 * damage * (u ^ 1.5))
   405→		local k = 1 + bulge + seam
   406→		local ax = 0
   407→		if rim then
   408→			k *= 1 + 0.17 * damage * segRand[idx] * math.sin(7 * th + phase)
   409→			ax = (finger[idx] - 0.55) * 0.16 * len * 0.35 - seam * 0.10
   410→		end
   411→		return k, ax
   412→	end
   413→	local outer, inner = {}, {}
   414→	for si, t in ipairs(stations) do
   415→		local rim = si == #stations
   416→		local ro, ri = {}, {}
   417→		for i = 1, NSEG do
   418→			local th = 2 * math.pi * (i - 1) / NSEG
   419→			local kk, ax = deform(th, t, rim, i)
   420→			local rO = 0.50 * flare(t) * kk
   421→			local pO = origin + uAx * (rO * math.cos(th)) + vAx * (rO * math.sin(th)) + dir * (t * len + ax)
   422→			ro[i] = {pO.X, pO.Y, pO.Z}
   423→			local rI = 0.36 * flare(t) * (1 + (kk - 1) * 0.85)
   424→			local aI = t * len + ax
   425→			if rim then aI -= 0.09 end
   426→			local pI = origin + uAx * (rI * math.cos(th)) + vAx * (rI * math.sin(th)) + dir * aI
   427→			ri[i] = {pI.X, pI.Y, pI.Z}
   428→		end
   429→		outer[si] = ro; inner[si] = ri
   430→	end
   431→	local function stripAdd(key, rings, i0, i1, flip, hard)
   432→		local vs, fs = {}, {}
   433→		for si = i0, i1 do
   434→			for i = 1, NSEG do vs[#vs + 1] = rings[si][i] end
   435→		end
   436→		for b = 0, (i1 - i0 - 1) do
   437→			local ob = b * NSEG
   438→			for j = 0, NSEG - 1 do
   439→				local k = (j + 1) % NSEG
   440→				local a, bb, c, d = ob + j + 1, ob + k + 1, ob + NSEG + j + 1, ob + NSEG + k + 1
   441→				if flip then
   442→					fs[#fs + 1] = {a, d, bb}; fs[#fs + 1] = {a, c, d}
   443→				else
   444→					fs[#fs + 1] = {a, bb, d}; fs[#fs + 1] = {a, d, c}
   445→				end
   446→			end
   447→		end
   448→		bin:addRaw(key, vs, fs, hard == true, 8.0)
   449→	end
   450→	stripAdd("nickel_pipe", outer, 1, 6, false, false)
   451→	stripAdd("torn_steel", outer, 6, 8, false, true)
   452→	stripAdd("pipe_bore", inner, 1, 8, true, false)
   453→	local function annulus(key, ro, ri, isEnd)
   454→		local vs, fs = {}, {}
   455→		for i = 1, NSEG do vs[i] = ro[i]; vs[NSEG + i] = ri[i] end
   456→		for j = 0, NSEG - 1 do
   457→			local k = (j + 1) % NSEG
   458→			local o0, o1, i0, i1 = j + 1, k + 1, NSEG + j + 1, NSEG + k + 1
   459→			if isEnd then
   460→				fs[#fs + 1] = {o0, o1, i1}; fs[#fs + 1] = {o0, i1, i0}
   461→			else
   462→				fs[#fs + 1] = {o0, i1, o1}; fs[#fs + 1] = {o0, i0, i1}
   463→			end
   464→		end
   465→		bin:addRaw(key, vs, fs, true, 8.0)
   466→	end
   467→	annulus("torn_steel", outer[8], inner[8], true)

   469→	-- don halkasi: ic cidar, agza yakin iki istasyon
   470→	local fr = {}

   473→		local ring = {}
   474→		for i = 1, NSEG do
   475→			local th = 2 * math.pi * (i - 1) / NSEG
   476→			local r = (0.36 - 0.014) * flare(t)
   477→			local p = origin + uAx * (r * math.cos(th)) + vAx * (r * math.sin(th)) + dir * (t * len)
   478→			ring[i] = {p.X, p.Y, p.Z}
   479→		end

   486→-- Kivrik yirtik metal seridi (cift yuz)
   487→local function curledShard(bin, base, uAx, vAx, fwd, th, rBase, ln)
   488→	local cw, sw = math.cos(th), math.sin(th)
   489→	local curl, w = 0.9, 0.16
   490→	local vs, fs = {}, {}
   491→	local steps = 4
   492→	for s = 0, steps do
   493→		local u = s / steps
   494→		local rr = rBase + 0.30 * u + curl * 0.16 * u * u
   495→		local ax = ln * u - curl * 0.22 * u * u
   496→		local c = base + uAx * (rr * cw) + vAx * (rr * sw) + fwd * ax
   497→		local tw = (uAx * (-sw) + vAx * cw) * (w * 0.5 * (1 - 0.5 * u))
   498→		local p1, p2 = c - tw, c + tw
   499→		vs[#vs + 1] = {p1.X, p1.Y, p1.Z}
   500→		vs[#vs + 1] = {p2.X, p2.Y, p2.Z}
   501→	end
   502→	for s = 0, steps - 1 do
   503→		local a = 2 * s + 1
   504→		fs[#fs + 1] = {a, a + 2, a + 3}; fs[#fs + 1] = {a, a + 3, a + 1}
   505→		fs[#fs + 1] = {a, a + 3, a + 2}; fs[#fs + 1] = {a, a + 1, a + 3}
   506→	end
   507→	bin:addRaw("torn_steel", vs, fs, true, 8.0)
   508→end

   510→-- Yarilmis / firlamis kriyo bant parcasi (kismi yay, cift yuz)
   511→local function splitBandStrip(bin, center, dir, r, arc0, arc1, tilt)
   512→	local uAx, vAx = pipeBasis(dir)
   513→	local width = 0.48
   514→	local n = 22
   515→	local vs, fs = {}, {}
   516→	for k = 0, n do
   517→		local th = arc0 + (arc1 - arc0) * k / n
   518→		for _, sgn in ipairs({-0.5, 0.5}) do
   519→			local p = center + uAx * (r * math.cos(th)) + vAx * (r * math.sin(th))
   520→				+ dir * (sgn * width + tilt * math.cos(th) * width)
   521→			vs[#vs + 1] = {p.X, p.Y, p.Z}
   522→		end
   523→	end
   524→	for k = 0, n - 1 do
   525→		local a = 2 * k + 1
   526→		fs[#fs + 1] = {a, a + 2, a + 3}; fs[#fs + 1] = {a, a + 3, a + 1}
   527→		fs[#fs + 1] = {a, a + 3, a + 2}; fs[#fs + 1] = {a, a + 1, a + 3}
   528→	end
   529→	bin:addRaw("cryo_band", vs, fs, true, 8.0)
   530→end

   550→local function buildRupturedSpool(kit, spoolId, p0, p1, bands, seedBase)
   551→	local model = Instance.new("Model")
   552→	model.Name = "PIPE_SPOOL_" .. spoolId .. "_RUPTURED"
   553→	model:SetAttribute("Faz4RupturedSpool", true)
   554→	model:SetAttribute("SpoolId", spoolId)
   555→	model.Parent = kit
   556→
   557→	local bin = MeshBin.new()
   558→	local dir = (p1 - p0).Unit
   559→	local L = (p1 - p0).Magnitude
   560→	bin:hollowFlange(p0 + dir * 0.16, dir, 0.50, 10)
   561→	bin:hollowFlange(p1 - dir * 0.16, dir, 0.50, 10)
   562→
   563→	local lenA, lenB = 0.42 * L, 0.40 * L
   564→	local phaseA = (seedBase % 628) / 100
   565→	local mouthA, uA, vA = tornStub(bin, p0, dir, lenA, seedBase, phaseA, 0.9)
   566→	local perp = (pipeBasis(dir))
   567→	local dB = (-dir + perp * math.tan(math.rad(3.0))).Unit
   568→	local orgB = p1 + perp * 0.09
   569→	local mouthB, uB, vB = tornStub(bin, orgB, dB, lenB, seedBase + 37, phaseA + 2.0, 1.25)
   570→
   571→	local shardThA = {0.6, 2.5, 4.4}
   572→	local shardLnA = {0.34, 0.30, 0.26}
   573→	for i, th in ipairs(shardThA) do
   574→		curledShard(bin, mouthA - dir * 0.10, uA, vA, dir, th + phaseA, 0.58, shardLnA[i])
   575→	end
   576→	for _, th in ipairs({1.4, 3.9}) do
   577→		curledShard(bin, mouthB - dB * 0.10, uB, vB, dB, th + phaseA, 0.60, 0.42)
   578→	end
   579→
   580→	for _, sb in ipairs(bands) do
   581→		local c = p0 + dir * sb
   582→		if sb < lenA - 0.35 then
   583→			bin:hollowPipeVec("cryo_band", c - dir * 0.24, c + dir * 0.24, 0.535, 0.495, 16, true, true)
   584→		elseif sb > L - lenB + 0.15 then
   585→			splitBandStrip(bin, c + perp * 0.09, dB, 0.545, 0.4, 4.1, 0.16)
   586→			splitBandStrip(bin, c + perp * 0.09 - dir * 0.05, dB, 0.545, 4.5, 6.0, 0.16)
   587→		else
   588→			splitBandStrip(bin, p0 + dir * (lenA - 0.55), dir, 0.545, 1.1, 4.6, 0.22)
   589→		end
   590→	end
   591→
   592→	local boltP = mouthA - dir * 0.04 + uA * 0.60
   593→	bin:cylVec("clamp", boltP - dir * 0.10, boltP + dir * 0.16 + vA * 0.06, 0.0375, 6, true, true)
   594→
   595→	bin:emitToModel(model, "PIPE_SPOOL_" .. spoolId .. "_RUPTURED")
   596→
   597→	-- Gizli dogar: hasar anina kadar gorunmez
   598→	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
   599→		if d:IsA("MeshPart") then
   600→			d.Transparency = 1
   601→			d.CastShadow = false
   602→		end
   603→	end
   604→	makeAnchor(model, "MOUTH_A", mouthA, dir)
   605→	makeAnchor(model, "MOUTH_B", mouthB, dB)
   606→end
